quickInfo.name: Multiball
quickInfo.summary: Complete the nine standup targets, shoot the lock to hold one ball, then plunge a lit Vortex hole to start three-ball play.

quickInfo.name: Jackpot order
quickInfo.summary: The Multiball Jackpot alternates from the left ramp to the right ramp and back.

quickInfo.name: Jackpot build
quickInfo.summary: The nine standup targets raise the Jackpot value.

quickInfo.name: Power Scoop
quickInfo.summary: The Skull lights an award; the Scoop collects whichever award the bumpers selected.

steps.text: Test the left ramp, right ramp, Skull hole, Scoop eject, and Croc Clock return under ball save.
Repeat the Windcoaster ramp while it returns under control and advances toward 3 Million Plus.
Complete the nine standup targets. The top-left Clock Shop shot can spot targets.
Shoot the lit lock to hold one ball, then plunge a lit Vortex hole to start three-ball Multiball.
Shoot the left ramp for the first Jackpot, then the right ramp for the next.
Continue alternating ramps; use standup targets to build value only when the extra balls protect their rebounds.
Return to the currently lit ramp after each collect instead of repeating the same side blindly.

alternatives.title: Bangarang combo
alternatives.when: Use this when both ramps and the Croc Clock shot are dialed in.

steps.text: Shoot the right ramp.
Follow with the left ramp.
Finish at the Croc Clock shot for the combo award.
Complete the standups, lock one ball, then plunge a lit Vortex hole to start Multiball.
Build the Jackpot through controlled standups.
Alternate left and right ramp collects throughout Multiball.

techniques.name: Alternating-ramp control
techniques.instruction: Trap after each Jackpot and transfer deliberately to the flipper that owns the newly lit ramp.

cautions.issue: The standups that build Jackpot can produce uncontrolled center rebounds.
cautions.response: Hit the standups only under Multiball protection or from a proven angle to raise the Jackpot.

input.simpleOverview: In Hook, repeat the Windcoaster ramp to advance its value toward 3 Million Plus. Complete the nine standup targets, lock one ball, then plunge a lit Vortex hole to start three-ball Multiball, where Jackpots alternate between the left and right ramps. Collect Power Scoop and Bangarang when they are ready instead of treating either as required preparation.
